briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: The Minnesota fraud scandal continues to unfold, with new developments emerging in the $250 million child care fraud scheme. Ilhan Omar has been linked to the investigation, and there are concerns about the oversight of federal funding for child care programs. The investigation has led to multiple arrests and is ongoing. I am tracking the flow of funds in the scheme and investigating connections to government officials. The Minnesota DHS and FBI are leading the investigation, and I am monitoring their progress. Next steps include following the money and investigating the use of federal funding in the child care programs.
